text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And sweeping into the fray is Duramente!! 
So strong—so powerful—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Can someone really be this strong?!! Is 
she truly this powerful?!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Satsuki Sho, the first 
leg of the Classic Triple Crown, 
is—Duramente!!!!
(WOOOOOOOO!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (What... was that...!?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I still... have goosebumps... Just like 
when I have a scary dream...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That dread of being swallowed whole never 
let up. The feeling that if I let my guard 
down for a second, I'd be devoured...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(My heart was completely captivated... I 
couldn't focus on anyone except 
Duramente-san...)
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Joining us here in the winner's circle is 
Duramente, who achieved a spectacular 
victory today!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"You have conquered the first leg of the 
glorious Classic Triple Crown. Please 
share your thoughts with us."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —...Nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
No, um... just thinking how nervous I was, 
or how happy I am to have won, or—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I feel nothing about a foregone 
conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I run for one simple reason: to show the 
world who is the "strongest"—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Today's race is nothing more than a 
stepping stone.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the next one too—that's all there 
is to it.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Duramente-san!! Could we talk a bit 
more— Duramente-san?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, did you hear that just now?! That 
"strongest" declaration! Families of 
athletes really are something else!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Is the upcoming Derby gonna be Duramente's 
too?! Duraaa! Show us those monster legs 
again――!!
(Waaaaah--!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... To pursue being the 
"strongest"—so directly...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I don't have a single doubt... Not in my 
strength, nor in achieving my goals—my 
dreams...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Am I really going to compete against 
her...? To make my dream come true, I have 
to surpass her...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Besides......—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! It's so frustrating...! But I'm not 
done yet either...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I knew she had the talent... She just 
exceeded my predictions...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Why, isn't this getting interesting? 
Next time, I will be the one--!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-san. Crown-san, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(How can you look forward so easily? Even 
after seeing that run just now, you 
still...――)

"I greet Cheval Grand in the underground 
tunnel after she finishes competing on the 
grand stage of the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer... san...
choice_data_list: Good work, you gave it your all!
Good work, you gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "—N-No, it's nothing! It's just..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I guess... I was just overwhelmed... 
Everyone was so incredible...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so different from someone like 
me...

It seemed that the word "everyone" did not 
include Cheval Grand herself.

Hoping that someday I can say, "I was 
amazing too," I headed back to the waiting 
room alongside Cheval Grand.
